_note: Name-form rules shared by verify-name-forms.mjs (deploy gate) and fix-name-forms.mjs (repair). Wherever the rendered English shows 'Translit (Name)', the Translit must be one of the allowed forms. fieldy 2026-09-09: Edom is ALWAYS Adawam, never Adam — the regression that reached prod (translation.db's pre-seeded rows were copied from an older render). Add a name per line to lock it. Gentilics get their own form (Adawamay = Edomites). divineAsHuman: a divine head-word (Yahawah / Alahayam / Adanay) glossed with a human or place name is always a mis-render; the repair swaps in name-map-expanded's spelling for that name. Every rule here FAILS the deploy — there are no warnings; a name spelled wrong is a broken verse.

forbidden.why: Edom is Adawam (H123 𐤀𐤃𐤅𐤌); Adam is the man (H121)

replace.why: the Name is Yahawah (possessive stays plain, as the corpus does: 31 × Yahawah's)
the Name is Yahawah (the empty () is the reader's gold-headword marker)

bareNames._note: A KJV name standing bare in the English (outside any gloss, not already a headword) is a verse that was never rendered: Joseph → Yawasap (Joseph), via name-map-expanded.json (values are translit(root) — the letters of the Hebrew). minLen keeps short/ambiguous keys out; skip lists spellings that name two different Hebrew names (see name-map-audit.txt CONFIRM) — those wait for a human. Also skipped: spellings that double as an ordinary word or as the app's own transliteration of another word (Raash, Achar, Alah, Halak, Token, Union…) — at a sentence start they would be misread as names.
